findings.reason: the section must name and extend the flight-layer exclusion/validator/accessor path (`reckon/flight.py`) or its new config key cannot resolve.
findings.text: §22 declares `review.plan_change_threshold` in `reckon/schema/flight-defaults.yaml` and reads it in the coverage predicate, but names no owner that makes a `review.*` key resolvable: `ReviewConfig` (`reckon/_flight_schema.py:230`) is `extra="forbid"` and carries no such field, so `reckon/flight.py` strips reckon-owned review keys before validation (`_schema_clean`, ~line 319-323) and validates and reads them separately (`plan_review_settle_seconds`, line 684; `validate_layer`, lines 862-868) — exactly the plumbing §7 of this same plan had to add for `plan_settle_seconds`; as written the key would raise `FlightConfigError` on every flight resolution or be unreadable

findings.reason: the plan should give the snapshot path one owner (a helper beside `review_report_directory` in `reckon/crew/plan_review.py`, or reuse of recovery's spelling) rather than spell the leaf a second time.
findings.text: §21 locates a stored review's snapshot through `review_report_directory` and asserts "no second spelling of the layout is added", but the snapshot leaf `plan.html` is spelled once today, in `recovery.py` when the dispatch composes it, and §21's predicate reads `directory / "plan.html"` again, so the layout gains a second spelling of its leaf

rubric_items.deep_module: pass — §16 replaces a spread of slicers (`_prose_slices`, the two `structured_section_spans` keywords, `_inside_structured_region`, the parser) with one `section_prose` reader hiding boundary, skip and strip behaviour, and §21/§22 push the snapshot read and change measure behind the one private `_review_coverage` predicate; no new shallow wrapper is added.
rubric_items.duplicate_owner: a finding — §21 adds a second spelling of the review snapshot leaf `plan.html` while claiming no second spelling of the layout is added; the leaf is spelled once today, in `reckon/crew/recovery.py`.
rubric_items.interface_budget: pass — public_definitions 1481, cli_options 317, mcp_views 33, refusal_families 23; §16 (net `section_prose` for a retired public `strip_tags`) and §23 (adds `store_delivered_reviews`, retires the private routing copy) each name what they add and retire, and §21 and §22 add to no family and say so.
rubric_items.reuse_search: a finding — §16 cites the readers it converges (`_TAG_RE`, `_PROSE_SKIP_TAGS`, `section_record_id`, `is_section_identity`, `_section_key`) and §21 cites `review_report_directory`/`_section_digests`/`_as_document`, but §22 adds `review.plan_change_threshold` without citing `reckon/flight.py`, the mechanism that already makes a `review.*` key resolvable.
rubric_items.thin_wrapper: pass — §23 hoists the one store step rather than forking it and justifies the `--answer` change (answering must not depend on a prior dispatch); §16's public `structured_section_spans` narrows back to its store contract over a shared private span rule with the reason stated, rather than wrapping new behaviour.
